record.paper_title: Open problems posed at the eighth international conference on fuzzy set theory and applications
record.original_question: Define an n-quasi-copula by keeping the boundary properties of an n-copula and replacing the n-copula volume condition with the 1-Lipschitz condition |Q(x1, ..., xn) - Q(y1, ..., yn)| <= sum_i |xi - yi|. Generated quasi-copulas are called Archimedean quasi-copulas; when n = 2, Archimedean quasi-copulas are necessarily copulas, while n-copulas form a proper subclass of n-quasi-copulas in general. Is there an algebraic characterization of Archimedean 3-quasi-copulas, and more generally of Archimedean n-quasi-copulas for n > 2?

evidence.quote: Replacing property (iii) of copulas by the 1-Lipschitz property ... the class of n-quasi-copulas is defined.
Generated quasi-copulas are called Archimedean quasi-copulas and, for n = 2, Archimedean quasi-copulas are necessarily copulas.
Is there an algebraic characterization for Archimedean 3-quasi-copulas (or, generally, for n-quasi-copulas with n > 2)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\geq 2$. An $n$-quasi-copula is a function $Q:[0,1]^n\to[0,1]$ satisfying:
(i) boundary conditions: $Q(u_1,\dots,u_n)=0$ whenever some $u_i=0$, and $Q(1,\dots,1,u_i,1,\dots,1)=u_i$ for every $i$ and every $u_i\in[0,1]$;
(ii) the 1-Lipschitz property: $|Q(x_1,\dots,x_n)-Q(y_1,\dots,y_n)|\leq\sum_{i=1}^n|x_i-y_i|$ for all $x,y\in[0,1]^n$.

A continuous, strictly decreasing function $\varphi:[0,1]\to[0,\infty]$ with $\varphi(1)=0$ is called an additive generator. Given such a $\varphi$, define
$$Q_\varphi(u_1,\dots,u_n)=\varphi^{[-1]}\!\bigl(\varphi(u_1)+\cdots+\varphi(u_n)\bigr),$$
where $\varphi^{[-1]}$ is the pseudo-inverse of $\varphi$. When $Q_\varphi$ is an $n$-quasi-copula, it is called an Archimedean $n$-quasi-copula.

It is known that for $n=2$ every Archimedean 2-quasi-copula is in fact a copula, while for $n\geq 3$ the class of $n$-copulas is a proper subclass of the class of $n$-quasi-copulas.

Problem: Provide an algebraic characterization of those generators $\varphi$ (equivalently, of those functions $Q_\varphi$) which yield Archimedean 3-quasi-copulas, and more generally Archimedean $n$-quasi-copulas for $n>2$.
artifact.status_search_result: A literature search reveals work on multivariate Archimedean quasi-copulas (e.g., results characterizing when generators yield n-quasi-copulas via d-monotonicity-type conditions of the generator) and algebraic characterizations of Archimedean n-copulas (Jouini–Clemen-type). However, no source directly identified as resolving the specific question of an algebraic characterization of Archimedean n-quasi-copulas for n>2 was located, so the current status is treated as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Multivariate Archimedean Quasi-Copulas
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses multivariate Archimedean quasi-copulas and conditions on generators.
status_evidence.claim: Work exists on multivariate Archimedean quasi-copulas but does not clearly furnish a definitive algebraic characterization for all n>2.

status_evidence.title: Characterizations of Archimedean n-copulas
status_evidence.snippet: Three characterizations of n-dimensional Archimedean copulas: algebraic, differential and diagonal.
status_evidence.claim: Algebraic characterizations are known for Archimedean n-copulas, distinct from the broader n-quasi-copula class.
